OBJECTIVE
Computer Science student looking for a summer internship or part-time programming role where I can learn from experienced developers and help out on real projects.

Shippensburg University of Pennsylvania — Shippensburg, PA
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, expected May 2028
Relevant coursework: Introduction to Programming (Python), Object-Oriented Programming (Java), Discrete Mathematics, Calculus I, Introduction to Web Development, Computer Organization

WORK EXPERIENCE
Sales Associate, Target — Carlisle, PA
June 2024 – Present (part-time, 15 to 20 hours a week during the semester, full-time in summer)
- Responsible for helping customers find products and answering questions about store policies and returns
- Operate the cash register and self-checkout area and handle exchanges and price checks
- Restock shelves and keep the electronics and home sections organized and faced
- Trained two new seasonal associates on register procedures during the 2025 holiday season

PROJECTS
Task Manager Web App (Online Course Project) — Spring 2026
- Built a to-do list application while following a Udemy full-stack web development course
- Used HTML, CSS, JavaScript and a small Node.js and Express server to add, edit and delete tasks
- Tasks are saved in the browser's local storage so they stay after the page is refreshed
- Added a dark mode toggle on my own after finishing the course videos

Student Grade Calculator (CSC 110 Assignment) — Fall 2025
- Wrote a Python program that reads grades from a text file and prints the class average, highest and lowest score
- Added input checking so the program does not crash on empty lines or letters where numbers should be
- Received full marks on the assignment

SKILLS
Programming languages: Python, Java, HTML/CSS, some JavaScript
Tools: VS Code, Git (basic), Microsoft Office, Google Docs
Soft skills: Communication, teamwork, time management, customer service
